snippet.title: "Little Red Riding Hood" by Scary Pixels- Short Horror Game - Trailer
snippet.description:
Videogame adaptation of Little Red Riding Hood, with a cutesy-creepy retro-inspired aesthetic. Free to play on itch.io via browser - no download necessary:
https://scary-pixels.itch.io/little-red-riding-hood
